title: Page 247
transc:
We suppose some force is going
to you from Java but for
want of communication we do not
know how they are getting along
We shall do our utmost to
assist you period Send us your
present postings signed Asia Clotilda yours 


Jaques Knoxville  Wash D. C.
2 am Sept. 21. 1863 
Delia Sept twenty first for Burton
Go to Bennet with your force
with out a moments delay Asia


JP Drouillard  Washn Sept 22" 63 
For Benjamin We have not a
word here as to the where
abouts or condition of your Walnut
up to a later point than
Sun set Sunday the twentieth period
your dispatches to me of Fanny
and to Applause of Hannah yesterday
tell us nothing later on those
points period Please relieve my anxiety
as to the position and condition
of your Walnut up to the
latest moment sig Asia Barbara Jones
